title: Maidan-E-Karbala Me Yeh Zainab Ke Bain Hai
body:
Maidan-E-Karbala Me Yeh Zainab Ke Bain Hai
Abbas Fouj-e-Shaam Me Tanha Hussain Hai
1.Hai Jiske Ek Ishare Me Kounain Ki Najaat
Ghudhe Se Jhoomta Hai Wahin Shah-e-Kayinath
Aajou Ab Madad Ku Hai Kuch Dur Hai Furat
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Pushte Faras Se Girta Hai Zehra Ka Noor-e-Aain
Rote Khade Hai Aale Paiyambar Bashoor-o-Shain
Zakhmou Se Chur Chur Hai Bhaiya Mera Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Buqz-o-Hasad Ke Zulm Ke Tevar Liye Howe
Hamraha Apne Saath Sitamgar Liye Howe
Shimre Layeen Badhta Hai Khanjar Liye Howe
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Mujh Bad Naseeb Se Mera Bhai Bhichadta Hai
Bhai Ka Kis Behan Ne Nazara Yeh Dekha Hai
Zaanu Daabe Ke Seene Maloon Baitha Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Zainab Ka Nouha Tha Jameel Akber Yeh Bar Bar
Abbas Aao Nehar Se Tum Par Behan Nisar
Zalim Ne Kaat Daala Sar-e-Shah-eZulfikhar
